lead: The mushroom for your mind. 1,000 mg of organic Lion's Mane — fruiting body and mycelium, standardized to 40% polysaccharides — in two daily capsules, to support memory, focus and long-term brain health.

science.title: Nature's nootropic
science.text: Lion's Mane has been studied for its unique compounds — hericenones and erinacines — that support nerve growth factor (NGF) and brain health. We use organic fruiting body and mycelium, standardized to 40% polysaccharides so every batch delivers a consistent, potent dose for memory, focus and clarity.
